calendar.semantics: Last expected TARGET operating date per month is chosen from calendar rules, independently of price presence; missing expected open dates are gaps, never forward-filled.

parsing_and_validation.encoding: UTF-8 or UTF-8 with BOM; preserve raw response bytes before parsing
parsing_and_validation.schema: Exact 32-column CSV schema in probe-metadata.json; unexpected additions, removals, or reordering fail closed pending review.
parsing_and_validation.key_identity: Each row key/dimension must agree with the requested series and currency; CURRENCY_DENOM=EUR, FREQ=D, EXR_TYPE=SP00, EXR_SUFFIX=A.
parsing_and_validation.row_identity: One row per TIME_PERIOD; duplicate, invalid, or out-of-range dates fail closed.
parsing_and_validation.status: Accept only OBS_STATUS=A (Normal value). Missing/unmarked or any other status is quarantined until reviewed.
parsing_and_validation.value_validation: At authorized full-history execution only, parse decimal text locale-independently; reject missing, nonfinite, or unparsable values. Never coerce silently.
parsing_and_validation.expected_dates: Compare rows with the expected TARGET calendar. Weekends/holidays are scheduled closures; missing expected open dates and unexpected dates are recorded separately.
parsing_and_validation.missing_data: No interpolation, carry-forward, backfill, or imputation. Missing expected open day is a source/data-quality gap.
parsing_and_validation.duplicates: Duplicates are not resolved by last-write-wins; fail closed and preserve raw response and metadata.
parsing_and_validation.request_failures: HTTP/network/parse failures are acquisition failures, not negative scientific outcomes.
parsing_and_validation.snapshots: Record retrieval UTC, exact URL/parameters, HTTP status/headers, byte count and SHA-256; store original bytes unchanged. Revisions are new snapshots, never overwrite prior raw bytes.

publication_and_vintage.historical_setting_time: UNKNOWN across the study history; Nov 2009 legacy TITLE_COMPL says 2:15 pm CET; current June 2026 framework describes setting around 14:10 CET and publication around 16:00 CET.
publication_and_vintage.safe_interpretation: Date-only reference association. No same-day tradability or information-set claim.

licensing.source_origin: Resolved: SOURCE_AGENCY=4F0 maps to European Central Bank in ECB official CL_ORGANISATION.
licensing.policy: ECB/ESCB public statistics reuse policy: free reuse of public statistics in standard format subject to source citation, unchanged official data/metadata and disclaimer; third-party data excluded; revisions may change data.
licensing.raw_snapshot_public_capture: Permitted for official standard CSV with citation and no alteration under reviewed ECB conditions.
licensing.derived_artifacts: No market-valued derived artifacts in this qualification. Any later transformation must be documented and retain source attribution.
